name: Code IDE ✨
description: Monaco editor with an on-device AI assistant
detailedDescription: A full code editor in your browser, powered by Monaco (the engine behind VS Code). Multi-file project tree, tabs, syntax highlighting, Vim keybindings, Prettier format-on-save, sandboxed JS runner, side-by-side diff, and git integration. Includes an opt-in on-device AI assistant (Hermes-3 via WebLLM, runs over WebGPU) that reads and edits workspace files through a dry-run + Apply diff. Saves to the HeymingOS filesystem when embedded, or to a real folder on disk via the File System Access API. No backend, no telemetry.
